meta.dataset: NEET UG college roster with hypothetical 2027 planning cutoffs
meta.rosterStatus: User supplied roster; financial and bond displays are preserved verbatim and unverified.
meta.cutoffStatus: 2027 display/projection year. Matching sourced AIR closing ranks are retained exactly as historical baselines, with their original source year. Rows without exact AIR evidence remain explicit planning assumptions.
meta.scoreToRankNotice: Preserved the existing 720-to-140 score/AIR mapping. NTA does not publish an exact rank for every score; the mapping retains its published-band uncertainty.
meta.nirfNotice: NIRF median-package values were not supplied or present in the existing medical records; values remain null rather than being inferred.
meta.stateQuotaCoverage: Retained only for colleges with existing sourced state-merit rows; no AIR-to-state-rank conversion.

projectionMethodology.historical-air-scenario: Carry forward the exact closing AIR for the latest matching college/course/quota/category source; prefer 2026 to older years. No 4% tightening or other scaling is applied. projectionYear/yearLabel describe the 2027 display; sourceYear and historicalReference retain the real source year and rank.
projectionMethodology.historical-category-proxy: When exact category AIR is absent, a UR-based category scenario may remain. The underlying source rank/year remain exact in historicalReference; the proxy is not an observed category cutoff or guaranteed 2026 evidence.
projectionMethodology.fee-tier-scenario: No college-specific historical AIR evidence. Open fee of 5L to 25L maps linearly to 150000 to 650000 AIR. SQ UR anchors: Karnataka90000, AP/Telangana110000, TN/Maharashtra75000, other100000. These are user-requested planning assumptions, not sourced cutoffs.
projectionMethodology.named-institute-scenario: Unvalidated AIR anchors: AFMC10000 (screening required), CMC5000 open/12000state, St Johns18000open/25000state, Kempegowda/MS Ramaiah40000. Never label these values official or calibrated.
projectionMethodology.public-college-scenario: No matching historical AIR: illustrative MBBS AIQ22000/SQ40000, BDS AIQ80000/SQ120000. Not a college-specific estimate.
projectionMethodology.categories: Illustrative factors UR1/EWS1.08/OBC1.20/SC1.85/ST2.10 only for reserved-route scenarios without exact evidence. Open/management and institute-specific scenarios use no caste advantage. National caste labels do not establish state-subcategory eligibility.
projectionMethodology.quotas: AIQ is a storage code for AIQ/central OR open/management/AFMC routes; quotaLabel distinguishes them. SQ is state counselling, not a universal85% share. Unsupported SQ has null rank and available=false, and is hidden in results.
projectionMethodology.fees: College annualFeeNumeric selects the primary Govt/State/Cat-A fee. Each cutoff row has the applicable state or management fee for budget filtering. Exact source display remains unchanged; a missing management fee is unknown, not the cheaper state fee.
projectionMethodology.stateMerit: Historical state merit ranks are never converted to AIR or used as AIR anchors.
projectionMethodology.confidence: No fitted probability model, 2027 seat matrix, validated college-specific fee-tier model or 2027 outcomes are available. Chance labels compare rank against the selected scenario only.
projectionMethodology.bds-fee-tier-scenario: Hypothetical, unvalidated BDS scenarios without college-specific historical AIR. Open fees 1L to 8L map linearly to 350000 to 1000000 AIR (unknown fee assumes 4L only for the rank scenario, not the budget filter). SQ UR anchors: Karnataka300000, AP/Telangana350000, TamilNadu280000, Maharashtra260000, other320000. Reserved-route category multipliers reuse the documented illustrative factors; no caste advantage is assumed for open management. These values are assumptions, not official cutoffs or a model fitted to the directory. The directory supplies historical state, ownership and intake metadata only; it does not establish 2027 admissions. Source-reported stopped admissions or unclear BDS intake have available=false and no projected rank.

bdsRegistry.status: Historical state/ownership/intake metadata; not a 2027 seat matrix or a cutoff source

cutoffAudit.policy: One active 2027 Projected Cutoff per college/course/quota/category. Exact latest matching historical AIR is carried forward unchanged. Original source years and all historical intervals remain preserved. Older/state-merit evidence and unsourced assumptions are never labeled as actual 2026 AIR.
